metadata.title: Vision — The Future I Am Building Toward
metadata.title_ru: Vision — Будущее, к которому я строю путь
metadata.description: A personal view of temporal AI presence, human development, digital sovereignty, robotics, verified experience, and Advanced Global Intelligence.
metadata.author: Ivan Kotov

hero.title: The Future I Am Building Toward
hero.quote: The future is not one intelligence above everyone. It is many forms of intelligence learning how to share reality.

reading_lenses.label: Likely
reading_lenses.text: Intelligence becomes cheaper, more distributed, more persistent, and more physically embedded.

reading_lenses.label: Worth building
reading_lenses.text: Local continuity, bounded authority, selective disclosure, repairable infrastructure, and livable intelligence.

reading_lenses.label: Already public
reading_lenses.text: Architecture, code, protocols, publications, evidence boundaries, and narrative work are routed through the public corpus.

nonclaims: Not every persistent AI system is c.
Continuity does not prove consciousness or personhood.
c does not eliminate inequality, manipulation, authoritarian politics, or technological risk.
L4 does not prove domination impossible.
Current law does not already recognise digital entities as legal subjects.
One architecture cannot predetermine all institutions of a future society.
